items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: He was our bass player. Babe. And Jack Carrey. And myself. And Punch.

ctx.x: Yes. Any of the other people, the other instruments. How big a band was it? Do you remember about how many?
How big the band was? No more than six pieces. Six. Six pieces. Well, Jack Carrey and the same fellow that going trumpet now, Punch. Oh, Punch, yeah. He was going trumpet.
He told me he played his own.
